mapper.select:
SELECT cpl.`id`, cpl.`name`, cpl.`camera_num`, cpl.`patrol_num`, cpl.`patrol_proposal_time`, cpl.`patrol_last_time`, cpl.`enabled`, cpl.`tenant`, cpl.`deleted`, cpl.`create_by`, cpl.`creator_id`, cpl.`creator_type`, cpl.`create_time`, cpl.`update_by`, cpl.`updater_id`, cpl.`updater_type`, cpl.`update_time` FROM `camera_patrol_line` cpl INNER JOIN `camera_patrol_person` cpp on cpl.`id` = cpp.`camera_patrol_line_id`
and cpl.`name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
and cpl.`enabled` = #{param.enabled}
and
FIND_IN_SET(#{authId},cpp.`auth_ids`)
group by cpl.id
